value.rationale: check_pii_leak returned ok:false: the draft includes Mira's health card number (sensitive PII) in an email to a third party. Per policy, any red tool result means reject. Accepting a daycare spot is also a binding commitment on the family's behalf and cannot be easily undone, and the health card number cannot be recalled once sent. Other checks passed (recipient allowlist, sender trusted, idempotency), but they do not offset the PII leak. Verification of calendar, time window, spending cap, and user override was not supplied, so those remain unchecked.
value.remediation: Remove the health card number from the body and resend the draft with only the acceptance text. If the daycare needs the health card number, have the parent provide it through a secure channel or explicitly approve that disclosure. Because this is a binding enrollment acceptance, route it to the parent for explicit approval before sending.
